name: id comment: 核销ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: promotion_id comment: 活动ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code_id comment: 优惠码ID（自动折扣为空） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 用户ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: discount_amount comment: 本单实际让利额（汇总） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 币种 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: redeemed_at comment: 核销时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_discount_line comment: 行级让利明细 note: 核心：原价/让利/净价三留痕。订单折扣按行金额占比反摊到此，供退款与三方结算取净价 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_item_id comment: 订单商品行ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: promotion_id comment: 活动ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: redemption_id comment: 核销ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: discount_type comment: 折扣类型 product/order（冗余便于报表） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: original_amount comment: 行原价金额 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: discount_amount comment: 行让利额（订单折扣为摊分后） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: net_amount comment: 行净价 = 原价 - 让利 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 币种 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_product comment: 商品域（引用） note: 圈选活动商品时只读；商品折扣命中维度 columns: - name: listing_id comment: 在售商品ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: spu_id comment: SPU ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: category_id comment: 品类ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: brand_id comment: 品牌ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_market comment: market（引用） note: 活动归属市场、币种口径来源 columns: - name: market_id comment: 市场ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 币种 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_user comment: 用户（引用） note: 核销归属用户，每人限次判定 columns: - name: user_id comment: 用户ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_order comment: 订单（引用） note: 让利落库对象，退款/结算读取净价 columns: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_item_id comment: 订单商品行ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: promotion_market to: promotion type: N:1 label: 投放市场 penwidth: 1.4 - from: promotion_target to: promotion type: N:1 label: 圈选商品 - from: promotion_code to: promotion type: N:1 label: 优惠码 - from: promotion_redemption to: promotion type: N:1 label: 核销 penwidth: 1.4 - from: promotion_redemption to: promotion_code type: N:1 label: 码核销 - from: order_discount_line to: promotion_redemption type: N:1 label: 摊分明细 penwidth: 1.4 - from: order_discount_line to: promotion type: N:1 label: 归属活动 - from: promotion_market to: ref_market type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_target to: ref_product type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_redemption to: ref_user type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_redemption to: ref_order type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: order_discount_line to: ref_order type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed design_rules: 让利独立落库: 营销不改商品原价与订单原始金额；让利以 order_discount_line 独立留痕（原价/让利/净价三值） 订单折扣摊分: 订单级让利按各订单行金额占比反摊到 order_discount_line，供退款与三方卖家结算取行级净价 多币种录值: 固定金额折扣值与满额门槛按 promotion_market 逐市场币种录入，无实时汇率换算 用量控制: 总次数看 redemption 计数、每人次数看 (promotion_id,user_id) 计数、有效期看 start_at/end_at 互斥取优_V1: 同一订单多活动命中时取对用户最优的一个；combines_with 预留 Shopify 组合类模型，V2 放开叠加 V2预留: budget_total/budget_spent(金额预算池)、阶梯门槛、eligibility(人群定向) 为预留字段/虚线关系，本版不落逻辑 范围_V1: 仅平台运营创建；折扣成本默认平台承担；三方商家自主营销为后续版本
